# Exercise the installed command's argument handling and process exit status.
exec nvtelemetry help
stdout 'Commands:'
stdout 'record'
! exec nvtelemetry unknown
stderr 'error: unknown command: unknown'
! exec nvtelemetry
stderr 'error: command required'
! exec nvtelemetry replay
stderr 'error: -input is required'

# Mock acquisition must work without NVML, including an output path with spaces.
mkdir recordings
env LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$WORK/no-nvml
exec nvtelemetry record -mock -duration 100ms -interval 10ms -output 'recordings/mock run.jsonl'
stderr 'Recording finished: [1-9][0-9]* samples collected'
stderr 'lost: 0'
exists 'recordings/mock run.jsonl'
exec nvtelemetry replay -strict -input 'recordings/mock run.jsonl'
stdout 'Stream verified \(strict\):'
stdout 'devices=1 phases=1 samples=[1-9][0-9]*'
exec nvtelemetry summary -input 'recordings/mock run.jsonl' -format json
stdout '"window": "measurement"'
stdout '"complete": true'
stdout '"device_uuid": "GPU-mock-0001'

# Corrupt and incomplete inputs must return a failing process exit status.
! exec nvtelemetry replay -strict -input corrupt.jsonl
stderr 'strict stream read failed:.*truncated telemetry record'
! exec nvtelemetry replay -strict -input incomplete.jsonl
stderr 'strict stream read failed:.*incomplete telemetry stream'
! exec nvtelemetry summary -input missing.jsonl
stderr 'error: open input:'

-- corrupt.jsonl --
{"manifest":{"run_id":"corrupt","schema_version":1}}
{"sample":
-- incomplete.jsonl --
{"manifest":{"run_id":"incomplete","schema_version":1,"devices":[]}}
